why.Rift: Owner-specified mode name in the brief (RIFT / BRIDGE / FRAY). Allowed ONLY as the player-facing name of the 5v5 mode and its queues. Never used for a map, objective, structure, fighter, item or currency. The registry denies it as a whole word because Riot uses it in its own product names; the risk is recorded in DESIGN_NOTE §Names, with a recommended alternative should the owner want one.
why.Vale: Product working title chosen by the owner.
